name: robin
brief: Robin, Siya's small bird companion: a compact Indian-folk firebird, small and chunky like a little hawk or robin (NOT a vulture, NOT a peacock, NOT a phoenix with long plumes). Small rounded red head with a short, strongly hooked golden beak, a dark friendly eye in a crimson eye-mask and a small curled golden crest. Short neck with a small cream-white ruff; cream belly. Vermillion-red back and wings; each wing has a cream leading edge and emerald-green feather tips, with marigold dot details. Tail: ONE SHORT, compact, rounded fan of marigold-orange feathers, about as long as the head, never long trailing plumes. Tiny talons tucked under the belly. Deep aubergine outline. Exactly the same small bird, size and proportions as attached image 1.
